356986:
**Steps:**
1. After entering the room, move all the way left to lure the chinchilla left, positioning it under the chest
2. Push the lower button, releasing the chest onto the head of the chinchilla
3. Lure the chinchilla right, until it is on the lower trapdoor
4. Push the upper button, to release the lower trapdoor
5. Lure the chinchilla right, so that it drops the chest on the upper button.
6. Keep luring the chinchilla right so that it drops down ONCE
7. Immediately switch to lure the chinchilla left, so that it can go stand on the lower button.
